macro: DFII10 latest observation available under conservative 2-US-federal-business-day lag; delta vs 20 prior nonmissing observations. BUY delta<=0, SELL delta>=0. Reject missing/stale >10 days. No threshold search.
event: Block new entry from 1min after public FOMC rate decision through +24h. No pre-event knowledge, no outcome/surprise/direction used. 63 regular decisions/emergency rate cuts; not CPI/NFP or every Fed announcement.
limitation: Current-vintage historical DFII10, may contain revisions; lag prevents same-day access but is not ALFRED point-in-time certification. XAU macro reconstruction unchanged and uncertified. Diagnostic OHLC paths, not tick parity.
parameters: No entry/SL/TP/risk/leverage/calendar changes; all three instruments share same account and execution. BTC10x XAU/EUR200x inherited frozen baseline.
